items.title: William Ballariel Interview, 1959-10-02
items.q: we did have Picnicoria with the Wise band from Pensacola

ctx.x: I wonder, did you ever hear any of the bands from New Orleans? Did they come over here? Did you hear any of the New Orleans musicians?

New Orleans bands? I, I remember one when I was quite young, I believe I heard one, but I don't, I don't know whether I was playing music then. But we did have Picnicoria with the Wise band from Pensacola and they, they were supposed to have one of the classic, the best colored bands there was in the south. That is, the real down straight playing music, you see. They didn't put no foolishness in their music, you see. They had won several prizes up in Chicago playing with them, yeah. What was the name band you…
Was this Wise band, the Brass band? Yeah, Brass band.
